headlines.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump’s Bid to Restrict Mail-in Ballot Rules
headlines.description: The Supreme Court on Monday rejected President Donald Trump’s efforts to restrict mail-in voting ahead of the midterm elections in November. NBC’s Laura Jarrett joins TODAY to break down what’s at stake with the decision.

headlines.title: Finneas and other acts exit Ed Sheeran tour in protest of Macklemore being dropped
headlines.description: Finneas and other musical artists have withdrawn as supporting acts for Ed Sheeran on Tuesday in protest of Macklemore being dropped from the tour after the rapper says New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft organized a boycott against him.

headlines.title: Trump’s handpicked Kennedy Center board again votes to close venue, calling it ‘unsafe’
headlines.description: The board voted shortly after a federal judge rejected its latest effort to add the president’s name to the building’s facade.

headlines.title: Iran war driving up inflation for Americans, CBO report says
headlines.description: The Congressional Budget Office estimates the war with Iran is the cause of more than one-third of the increase in inflation this year and that it will cause further increases in the first quarter of next year, according to a new report released Tuesday.

headlines.title: U.S. and China face grave AI risks but mutual distrust stalls cooperation
headlines.description: The United States and China are both gripped by safety fears as they reckon with their rapid advances in AI, but intensifying competition and deep mutual distrust could derail the kind of cooperation experts say is vital to head off the strategically vital technology’s greatest dangers.

headlines.title: Watch highlights of the 2026 Emmy Awards in 3 minutes
headlines.description: Apple TV's "Widow's Bay", "Pluribus," and HBO’s "The Pitt" received major awards at the 2026 Emmy Awards, with horror-comedy "Widow's Bay" taking home some of the night’s biggest awards, including outstanding comedy series, outstanding directing, outstanding lead actor Matthew Rhys, and outstanding supporting actress for Kate O’Flynn.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Magazine from 1894 is finally returned to New Hampshire public library
headlines.description: A magazine, checked out and overdue from a New Hampshire library, has finally been returned — perhaps as long as 132 years late.

headlines.description: Finneas and other musical artists have withdrawn as supporting acts for Ed Sheeran on Tuesday in protest of Macklemore being dropped from the tour after the rapper says New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft organized a boycott against him.

headlines.title: FBI Director Kash Patel clashes with Democrats at oversight hearing
headlines.description: Lawmakers pressed FBI Director Kash Patel during a contentious oversight hearing on Tuesday about his leadership of a bureau that has seen massive changes since the start of President Donald Trump’s second term.

headlines.title: Hyrox co-founder apologizes after athlete allowed to continue despite defecating on herself
headlines.description: Professional athlete Joanna Wietrzyk was seen on video and in photographs running and using shared fitness equipment with feces running down her legs.

headlines.title: Texas QB Arch Manning apologizes for ‘insensitive comment’ over AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized Tuesday for referencing an AI video of his head coach Steve Sarkisian slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe in the wake of Texas’s win over Ohio State over the weekend.
